create_dpmsolver_sde_scheduler: create a DPMSolverSDEScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and Karras sigmas for diffusion sampling
set_timesteps_dpmsolver_sde: set the discrete timesteps and sigma schedule for a DPMSolverSDE scheduler before inference
step_dpmsolver_sde: step the DPMSolverSDE scheduler to predict the previous sample by reversing the SDE diffusion process
add_noise_dpmsolver_sde: add noise to original samples using the DPMSolverSDE scheduler sigma schedule at specified timesteps
create_brownian_tree_noise_sampler: create a BrownianTreeNoiseSampler backed by torchsde for generating batched Brownian motion noise samples
